incidents.name: Bizness
incidents.notes: splitLock's ETH refund triggers receive() reentrancy into withdrawLock, double-spending the locked tokens (state-changing reentrancy).

sources.ref: Onchain review: Locker 0xd6a7cfa86a41b8f40b8dfeb987582a479eb10693 created 2024-11-08T04:02:55Z (Base block 22124614) by 0x01a7f4aaf9280252fa4334786e1cacdbd3d2ca68, not the attack-tx sender 0x3cc1edd8a25c912fcb51d7e61893e737c48cd98d. keccak(eth_getCode) is identical at the creation and incident blocks, no EIP-1967/beacon slot is set and storage slots 0-25 are empty, and the exploit trace contains no DELEGATECALL out of the victim - the only delegatecall in the verified source bundle is OpenZeppelin's Address.functionDelegateCall, unreachable in this non-proxy contract. Deployment basis is exact.

onchain review: victim re-anchored from implementation 0xd6a7cfa86a41b8f40b8dfeb987582a479eb10693 to the proxy the protocol runs at, 0x80b9c9c883e376c4aa43d72413ab1bd6a64a0654, which holds that implementation in its EIP-1967 slot and emits the exploit transaction's logs while the implementation emits none; age measured from when the proxy started running the implementation rather than from the implementation's own deployment (4315200s -> 4315194s)
